notes: New in 2.3.4: reactions feel natural now. Your WhatsApp Agent no longer reacts to every message. By default it reacts only now and then, when it fits, like a friend texting: 👍 when you give it a task that will take a while, ✅ when that task is done, ❤️ for thanks or good news, 😂 for something funny, 🙏 for a favour. Most messages get no reaction. Choose in Settings → Channels → WhatsApp Agent → Reactions: "Natural (AI decides)" (the default; you are moved to it by this update), "Every message (👍)" (the 2.3.3 way, with the emoji choice), or "Off" (no reactions at all). In Natural mode it never reacts to more than 2 of your messages in a row.
